name: bugfix
title: Bug fix
description: Reproduce a bug as a failing test, find its root cause, fix it, verify the fix and ship it.

mainBranch.description: Default branch that fix branches start from and pull requests target

testCommand.description: Command that runs the full test suite

bugNotesDir.description: Directory (relative to the project root) where bug notes (reproduction, diagnosis, verification) are written

fixBranchPrefix.description: Prefix for your bug fix branch names

reviewer.description: GitHub handle (without the leading @) to request pull request reviews from; leave empty to choose per pull request

reproduce-bug.description: Reproduce a reported bug reliably and capture it as a failing automated test. Use when starting work on a bug report, crash or regression.

diagnose-bug.description: Find the root cause of a reproduced bug and agree on a fix approach before changing code. Use once the bug reproduces reliably.

BACK.description: The reproduction turned out to be wrong or incomplete

fix-bug.description: Fix the diagnosed root cause with the smallest safe change and make the reproduction test pass. Use after diagnosis or when verification failed.

BACK.description: The fix showed that the diagnosis was wrong

verify-fix.description: Verify that the fix removes the bug, the full suite passes and nothing nearby regressed. Use after the fix is committed.

FAILED.description: The bug still reproduces or something regressed

ship-fix.description: Ship the verified fix by pushing the branch and opening a pull request that explains cause and fix. Use when verification passes.

CHANGES_REQUESTED.description: Pull request reviewers or CI require code changes
